title: Jennie Sings About Sisterhood in a New Song for Netflix's Steps
summary: Jennie has a new song, 'Someone to Hold,' about love between sisters. The Blackpink singer made it for Steps, a new Netflix cartoon movie, with producer Justin Tranter. Jennie was excited to join the Steps family. Her first song for a cartoon movie was fun. Steps is a new take on Cinderella, directed by Alyce Tzue and John Ripa. Lilith, voiced by Ali Wong, is tired of Cinderella's shadow. She takes the Fairy Godmother's magic wand and takes over the Royal Ball with her sister Margot, voiced by Stephanie Hsu. Then Lilith must team up with Cinderella, voiced by Amanda Seyfried, to save the kingdom from Priscilla, a villain voiced by Nikki Glaser, and fix their relationship. The movie streams on Netflix on November 20. Its soundtrack has four new songs by Tranter, with extra singing by Seyfried, Rose Gray, and Emei. Kris Bowers made the score. Jennie has had a busy year. In March, she released Ruby, her first solo EP with 15 tracks, and later rejoined Blackpink for a tour and the album Deadline.
why_it_matters: It shows how sisters can argue, team up, and look out for each other, just like siblings at home.
